title: iCATS: Fast Video Generation via Interaction-Aware Sparse Attention and Timestep-Adaptive Sparsity
title_zh: iCATS：通过交互感知稀疏注意力与时间步自适应稀疏性实现快速视频生成

paragraphs.en: iCATS是一种通过交互感知稀疏注意力和时间步自适应稀疏性提高视频生成速度的方法。 Training-free sparse attention offers a practical acceleration solution to Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) via reducing computations without fine-tuning. It typically involves estimating the importance of query-key regions and deriving sparse masks to compute only the important candidates, which inevitably introduces approximation errors that may degrade generation quality. To better balance the efficiency-quality trade-off, we propose iCATS, integrating improved importance estimation and sparse mask construction with an efficient hardware execution strategy. Specifically, for importance estimation, unlike previous works that perform independent clustering over query and key tokens based on feature similarity to estimate attention scores, iCATS demonstrates that clustering based on query-key dot-product interactions is more accurate and further reformulates this objective as a simple quadratic form for low-cost computation. For sparse mask construction, instead of using a fixed top-p rule, we observe that tolerance to sparse approximation errors varies across denoising timesteps and therefore introduce an SNR-guided sparsity schedule to adjust sparsity dynamically, leading to higher accuracy. Finally, for hardware execution, we devise a tail-merging strategy to reduce padding overhead caused by irregular cluster sizes, improving GPU kernel utilization. Extensive experiments show that iCATS achieves $2.03\times$ acceleration with 31.017 dB PSNR on HunyuanVideo-T2V-13B and $1.55\times$ acceleration with 29.301 dB PSNR on Wan2.1-T2V-14B, delivering a state-of-the-art efficiency-quality trade-off.
paragraphs.zh: iCATS是一种通过交互感知稀疏注意力和时间步自适应稀疏性来提高视频生成速度的方法。无需训练的稀疏注意力通过减少计算量而不需微调，为扩散变换器（DiTs）提供了一种实用的加速方案。 该方法通常涉及估计查询-键区域的重要性，并推导出稀疏掩码以仅计算重要的候选项，但这不可避免地会引入近似误差，可能降低生成质量。 为了更好地平衡效率与质量之间的权衡，我们提出了iCATS，它将改进的重要性估计和稀疏掩码构建与高效的硬件执行策略相结合。 具体而言，在重要性估计方面，不同于以往工作基于特征相似性对查询和键标记进行独立聚类以估计注意力分数，iCATS证明了基于查询-键点积交互的聚类更为准确，并进一步将该目标重构成一个简单的二次形式以实现低成本计算。 在稀疏掩码构建方面，我们并未采用固定的top-p规则，而是观察到对稀疏近似误差的容忍度在不同去噪时间步中存在差异，因此引入了一种由信噪比（SNR）引导的稀疏度调度机制来动态调整稀疏性，从而实现了更高的准确性。 最后，在硬件执行方面，我们设计了一种尾部合并策略，以减少不规则聚类尺寸所导致的填充开销，从而提升GPU内核的利用率。 大量实验表明，iCATS在HunyuanVideo-T2V-13B上实现了$2.03\times$的加速且PSNR为31.017 dB，在Wan2.1-T2V-14B上实现了$1.55\times$的加速且PSNR为29.301 dB，达到了当前最先进的效率与质量平衡。
